# springDamperVelocityOffsetTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [springDamperVelocityOffsetTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/springDamperVelocityOffsetTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The velocityOffset of CoordinateSpringDamper, CartesianSpringDamper and RigidBodySpringDamper (#829, #1631):
#           a damper between the ground and a mass, without spring, drives the mass towards the velocity offset,
#           m*v_t = -d*(v - vOff), so v(t) = vOff*(1 - exp(-d*t/m)) - instead of a user function that moves the damper.
#           Run directly, the SolutionViewer shows the three masses: the Mass1D (blue, drawn above the others), the mass
#           point (orange) and the rigid body, which also turns.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-12
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
import numpy as np
from exudyn import cMath
import exudyn.graphics as graphics

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)

SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()

m = 2.
d = 4.
tEnd = 1.
vOff = 0.5
oGround = mbs.CreateGround()

#coordinate spring-damper on a 1D mass
nGround = mbs.AddNode(NodePointGround())
mGroundCoordinate = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodeCoordinate(nodeNumber=nGround, coordinate=0))
n1D = mbs.AddNode(Node1D(referenceCoordinates=[0]))
mbs.AddObject(Mass1D(nodeNumber=n1D, mass=m, referencePosition=[0, 0.3, 0], #drawn above the others
                     visualization=VMass1D(graphicsData=[graphics.Sphere(radius=0.05, color=graphics.color.blue)])))
mbs.AddObject(CoordinateSpringDamper(markerNumbers=[mGroundCoordinate, mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodeCoordinate(nodeNumber=n1D, coordinate=0))],
                                     stiffness=0, damping=d, velocityOffset=vOff))

#Cartesian spring-damper on a mass point, three velocity offsets
massPoint = mbs.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[0, 0, 0], mass=m,
                                graphicsDataList=[graphics.Sphere(radius=0.05, color=graphics.color.orange)])
mbs.AddObject(CartesianSpringDamper(markerNumbers=[mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyPosition(bodyNumber=oGround)),
                                                   mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyPosition(bodyNumber=massPoint))],
                                    stiffness=[0, 0, 0], damping=[d, d, d], velocityOffset=[vOff, -vOff, 2*vOff]))

#rigid-body spring-damper on a rigid body: a translational and an angular velocity offset
inertia = InertiaCuboid(density=1000, sideLengths=[0.1, 0.1, 0.1])
J = inertia.inertiaTensor[2, 2]
body = mbs.CreateRigidBody(inertia=inertia, referencePosition=[0, 0, 0])
mbs.AddObject(RigidBodySpringDamper(markerNumbers=[mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=oGround)),
                                                   mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=body))],
                                    stiffness=np.zeros((6, 6)), damping=np.diag([d, d, d, d, d, d]),
                                    velocityOffset=[vOff, 0, 0, 0, 0, vOff]))

mbs.Assemble()
simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 1000
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = tEnd
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = not testIsActive #for the SolutionViewer
mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
if not testIsActive:
    mbs.SolutionViewer()

def Exact(vOffset, mass):
    return vOffset*(1 - cMath.exp(-d*tEnd/mass))

v1D = mbs.GetNodeOutput(n1D, exu.OutputVariableType.Coordinates_t)
vMassPoint = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(massPoint, exu.OutputVariableType.Velocity, localPosition=[0, 0, 0])
vBody = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(body, exu.OutputVariableType.Velocity, localPosition=[0, 0, 0])
omegaBody = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(body, exu.OutputVariableType.AngularVelocity, localPosition=[0, 0, 0])
exu.Print('coordinate spring-damper:', v1D, 'exact', Exact(vOff, m))
exu.Print('Cartesian spring-damper: ', vMassPoint, 'exact', [Exact(v, m) for v in [vOff, -vOff, 2*vOff]])
exu.Print('rigid-body spring-damper:', vBody[0], omegaBody[2], 'exact', Exact(vOff, inertia.Mass()), Exact(vOff, J))

values = [v1D, vMassPoint[0], vMassPoint[1], vMassPoint[2], vBody[0], omegaBody[2]]
exact = [Exact(vOff, m), Exact(vOff, m), Exact(-vOff, m), Exact(2*vOff, m), Exact(vOff, inertia.Mass()), Exact(vOff, J)]
errors = sum(int(abs(a - b) > 1e-4*max(1, abs(b))) for (a, b) in zip(values, exact))
u = errors + sum(values)
exu.Print('solution of springDamperVelocityOffsetTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
